svg.title: LishayGFX
svg.desc: Based in Israel. Owner of openowl.cc and valkbypass.com. Working on new projects and developing current ones. Discord: lishaygfx and neverwentlegit. Rotating ASCII torus knot from ASCII Magic. LishayGFX builds websites, apps and FiveM scripts. Stack: Lua and JavaScript for FiveM scripting; HTML, CSS, React and Next.js for interfaces; Rust, C++, Node.js, custom APIs, custom DLLs and discord.js bot work; Python apps with pywebview. On GitHub since 2021. 2 public repositories, 0 public repository stars, 0 followers. Atlas Survival: Official Atlas Survival Minecraft resource pack releases. Latest stable release v1.0.8. Animated contribution calendar. Updated 2026-11-13 UTC.
